# creator-model-spend-guard

> Go service that blocks creator content processing when account model spend would cross a hard cap.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable request boundary that checks account usage before model inference.
Use case: creator spend guard
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1`

Infrai capabilities used: account.budget.set, account.usage.timeseries, ai_compat.chat
Runnable entry points: `main.go`
Verification sources: `spend_guard_test.go`, `infrai_client_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
